create.heading: New poll
create.title: Title
create.optionsHelp: Add at least two candidate times. Adding the same time twice merges it into one option.
create.defaults: Defaults: 4 minimum, 4 maximum, 2 hours, 24-hour deadline, no platform, not private.

validation.range: Enter a value in the allowed range.
validation.minMax: Minimum attendance cannot exceed maximum capacity.
validation.invitedFriend: A non-private poll needs at least one invited friend.
validation.tooManyInvitees: You can invite up to 50 friends.
validation.tooManyGuestLinks: You can create up to 20 guest links.
validation.optionMinimum: Add at least two candidate times.
validation.optionCap: A poll can have at most 12 candidate times.

list.heading: Polls
list.emptyDiscoverable: No open polls to discover right now.

detail.awaitingSelectionNotice: Voting has closed. The organizer is choosing a time.
detail.expiredPendingNotice: This poll's selection window has closed.
detail.expiredNotice: This poll expired without a selection.
detail.noVoteYet: You have not voted on this option yet.

suggest.heading: Suggest a time
suggest.optionCap: This poll already has 12 candidate times — the most it can hold.

prefill.pollTruncated: Only the first {{max}} candidate times from your selection were kept — a poll can have at most {{max}}.

mute.copy: Muting suppresses everything about this poll except your reminder while you're Going or Maybe. Unmuting does not backfill — nothing missed while muted is queued to deliver later.
mute.disabledTerminal: Muting is not available once a poll is finalized, expired, or canceled. For a finalized poll, mute the session it created instead.

finalize.heading: Choose a time
finalize.previewGuarantee: This preview and finalizing use the same rule — the same inputs always produce the same result. If something changes in between (an option is removed, or someone's access changes), the outcome may differ from what's shown here.
finalize.confirmBody: This creates a session at {{time}} and cannot be undone.

cancel.title: Cancel this poll?
cancel.body: This cannot be undone. Guests lose access to this poll immediately, and their invitation links stop working.

guests.heading: Guest links
guests.removeConfirm: This removes their votes and revokes their link. This cannot be undone.

guestPoll.expired: This poll's selection window has closed.
guestPoll.finalized: This poll was finalized. Re-open your invitation link for the session.

dirty.title: Discard unsaved changes?
dirty.body: You have unsaved changes. If you leave now, they will be lost.
